messages:
Nora (AE): Heads-up team  Meridian Bank sent a 92-question RFI + capability matrix. They want technical answers, security questionnaire, POC SOW, and pricing bands for Dedicated vs Private. Deadline next Wed EOD. I've uploaded raw file to /shared/meridian/rfi/meridian_rfi_v2.xlsx. Can we split?

Chen (SE): I can own the capability matrix and throughput sizing. Quick clarifying Q: they asked specifically about int8 and int4 support. Should we differentiate host availability per model or give a general statement?

Nora (AE): Call out per-model availability. They want explicit note whether Hosted offers quantized flavors for production.

Priya (Platform): Short suggested line for matrix: "Quantization (int8/int4) 8 Supported on Dedicated and Private with validated runtime profiles. Hosted may offer select quantized variants per model; availability will be listed in the model catalog and may be subject to performance validation."

Isla (Security): I'll take the security questionnaire. Looks like 30 standard items + PCI and HSM follow-ups. Flagging export controls and vendor indemnity rows for Legal.

Zoe (Legal): Thanks. Ping me on flagged rows. For indemnity/model-license Qs we should add: "Subject to third-party model vendor terms; Redwood can assist coordination but cannot assume vendor indemnities without a separate agreement."

Marco (Sales): I'll draft POC pricing and SOW. Need Chen's sizing for 100/500/1000 QPS (embedding-heavy vs gen-heavy) to estimate Dedicated pool size and burst pricing. Also include optional on-site audit fee and HSM appliance support as add-ons.

Chen (SE): Quick estimate pasted: "Embedding-heavy (80% embeds, 256 tokens avg): 100 QPS -> ~20k tks/s, 500 QPS -> ~100k tks/s, 1k QPS -> ~200k tks/s. Gen-heavy (30% gen, avg 1.2k tokens): 100 QPS -> ~96k tks/s, 500 QPS -> ~480k tks/s." Will refine numbers and attach small table in the matrix.

Isla (Security): Sample security answers: TLS1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest, SOC2 report available under NDA, RBAC for console, BYOK via AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault; HSM-backed signing recommended on Private. For PCI attestation: "We support PCI-compliant deployment patterns (Private/Dedicated with hardened controls); formal PCI attestation requires scoped engagement."

Nora (AE): They also asked how we handle Dedicated capacity exhaustion. Suggested short wording?

Priya (Platform): "Smart routing with configurable fallback to compatible model variants or alternate region. Customers may pin model versions per route to prevent fallback where strict SLAs are required."

Marco (Sales): POC SOW sketch: "Week 0: provisioning & VPC peering; Week 1-2: ingest + perf baselines; Week 3: security validation + optional Private smoke test (BYOK/HSM); Week 4: report, runbook, and handoff." I'll draft pricing ranges and upload pricing_sheet_meridian.csv and poc_sow_meridian.pdf to the drive folder.

Isla (Security): Logging question: "Who accesses logs?" Answer: "For Private, logs remain customer-controlled. For Hosted/Dedicated, tenant-scoped logs are accessible to authorized SRE/support with audited access; optional export to customer S3/GCS available."

Zoe (Legal): I'll prepare a short escalation paragraph for the submission around PCI timing and model-license caveats. Also confirm if they require EU data residency commitments. Nora?

Nora (AE): Yes, Meridian is EU+US hybrid and wants EU residency for EU customers. Note that in the RFI responses.

drive-bot: Snapshot created: https://drive.internal/s/meridian/rfi/submission_bundle/ :white_check_mark:

Nora (AE): Timeline: Chen by Mon 10am for matrix draft, Isla Mon 2pm for security draft, Marco Mon 4pm for pricing + POC SOW, Zoe Mon 5pm for legal escalations. I'll consolidate Tue morning and run a final pass Tue afternoon. Tag me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
